sources: web search result summary of cear.gsu.edu (CEAR working papers 2025-26, titles/authors partial)
notes: Very long CV (c.2021, ~200 items) parsed by script: kept journal articles/refereed items, skipped book chapters, reviews, editor entries, comments/replies, encyclopedia and reports. CV only says 'with X and Y' so authors are listed alphabetically by surname including Harrison (byline order not confirmed); some accented names ASCII-normalised from garbled PDF text (spot-check). Parsing is automatic: venue/year may be imperfect (year = first year in citation). CV predates 2022; recent works (e.g. JPE 2026, IER 2025, JRI 2025, other CEAR WPs 2025-26) known only from a search snippet without full author lists, so omitted except 6 CEAR WPs whose authors were shown (surnames only for some coauthors). 'Literacy and the Quality of Index Insurance Decisions' and 'Eliciting Beliefs about COVID-19' marked forthcoming per CV (likely published since).
